collection.description: A child and friends have opened a mud bakery on the beach, and a passing villager is called over to buy a cake.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (subject.his/her) friends have opened a bakery on the beach. Everything is made of mud. There are mud cakes, mud loaves and a mud pie with a shell on top that is apparently very special. (friend) is walking past and is immediately called over. "Would you like to buy a cake?"

choices.label: Ask for Something That Isn't on the Menu

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) pays with three pebbles, which the children examine very carefully before accepting. (friend.He/She) is handed a mud cake on a leaf. All the children watch to see what (friend.he/she) will do. (friend) pretends to take a bite and says, "This is the best cake I have ever eaten." The children are so pleased that (friend) is given the special pie for free.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Do you have any fish?" asks (friend). The children look at each other in alarm. A whispered meeting is held. Then (subject) turns round with great dignity and says, "We have a mud fish. It will take a moment." It takes quite a long moment. It is worth the wait.
